20	    [

24	      "  rrrrsf ", // z72: rug, chair, writing table (door at x50)
25	      " Lrrrr   ", // z73: rug, standing lantern on the west wall (lights the south-west)
26	      " c       ", // z74: wardrobe chest
27	      "         ", // z75: south wall
28	    ],
29	    [
30	      "         ",
31	      "   L     ", // y12 z70: lantern on the nightstand
32	      "         ",
33	      "       T ", // y12 z72: table top slab on the fence
34	      "         ",
35	      "         ",
36	      "         ",
37	    ],
38	    [
39	      "         ",
40	      "         ",
41	      "         ",
42	      "       P ", // y13 z72: flower pot on the table top
43	      "         ",
44	      "         ",
45	      "         ",
46	    ],
47	  ]);
48	  bed(g, [54, 11, 71], "north", "red");
49	  porchLantern(g, 54, 16, 73);
50	}
